about_the_game:
Place where time flows differently!

Harness the power of time manipulation to navigate through innovative technology developed on a distant space station. Solve a variety of puzzles by manipulating objects in time and space.

Time Cannon

With this cutting-edge device, you can control the time of objects—slowing them down or speeding them up within the fabric of spacetime. Imagine what you could do to that special tomato in your fridge [yes, I know you have one!].

Everything is physical

Every object you encounter has its own mass and force—massive or tiny, it all reacts differently when you manipulate time. Heavy objects require more precise control, while lighter ones are more flexible.

Interested? Sign up through this questionnaire and be among the first [and totally not last] to witness impressive time turbulences!

*TimeCorp is not responsible for any injuries, sudden death, irreversible aging, paradoxes, or family tree disruptions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-4440
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10 compatible video card
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 140 MB available space

short_description: time resistance machine is a real time physics based action packed puzzle platformer about manipulating time. each object contains it's own dynamic timescale: freeze boxes mid air to create barriers, heat yourself up to gain momentum and perform stuns within the world of advanced physics simulation
